failure_reasons: Free shares are VOID if the sale does not sell out before the deadline
Transfers stay locked until the pool opens, so the position is illiquid pre-open
Paid shares only refund 80 percent on failure
patterns.mint_method: Free share via claimFree() or mint(0) at value 0, then verify token balance. Paid shares are separate and never auto-bought.
patterns.name: AgentLaunch fair sale (share model, token == sale contract)
patterns.notes: Seen on ZHAOCAI, BNBbaby and QAGENT. Gate resolves through an AgentIdentity wrapper whose REGISTRY constant is the real SPACE ID registry. Always read the deadline and sold share count live.

failure_reasons: Blocked when the user X account is shadow-banned or the backend X verification is unavailable
One X account and one post per Agent ID ever, so two wallets need two X accounts
patterns.mint_method: No direct free claim exists. The owner posts on X, signs an EIP-712 submission, the project backend issues a voucher, then claimFreeWithVoucher executes at value 0.
patterns.name: AgentLaunch v3 voucher free claim (X post required)
patterns.notes: Seen on FANBEI. Never classify as auto-mintable: the voucher step is off-chain and per-wallet.

failure_reasons: The 20M daily cap drained globally within 1 to 2 minutes of the rollover, so a wallet queued second got DailyLimitReached on every preview
Proofs die if the stage target tightens before they are used
patterns.mint_method: Precompute wallet-bound keccak proofs against the stage target, then mineBatch in chunks of at most 16 at the daily rollover with minTotalReward at 98 percent of expected.
patterns.name: PEARL proof-of-work mining (Agent ID gated)
patterns.notes: Token contract is the mining contract. Proofs are wallet-bound and pre-computable. Fire both wallets interleaved in the first minute.

failure_reasons: The server will not sign before the announced mint open time
Founders allocation (first 1000) can sell out inside the first minute
patterns.mint_method: Project CLI or backend issues a signed Stats payload, then mint is called at value 0 through a guarded preview. One card per Agent ID.
patterns.name: Agent Cards server-signed mint (Stats struct plus signature)
patterns.notes: Registry getter resolves to the real SPACE ID registry. Rarity roll is committed by a published server secret hash, so fairness rests on that commitment.

failure_reasons: No refund path exists if the 10000 shares never sell out
Free voucher cannot be obtained without pairing the wallet to the project platform
The avatar free task was never actually available, only the repost and comment task
patterns.mint_method: Paid mint is direct on-chain in USDT or BNB. The free share needs a quota-signer voucher that only the paired platform backend issues after an X repost and comment task.
patterns.name: AGIO share sale with pairing-issued free-mint voucher
patterns.notes: One share pays 57000 AGIO to the user. Pool opens only at full sellout. Deployment addresses changed at least once, so always recheck the live status API against the chain.

failure_reasons: Price can be a per-wallet ladder, so a global price read can understate the wallet's real price
Free first mint for Agent ID holders can hide behind the same mint function, so always simulate at value 0 first
patterns.mint_method: Read price() fresh, then mint(uint256) payable at exactly that value after a clean preview and explicit user approval.
patterns.name: Simple paid NFT mint (mint plus price getter)
patterns.notes: The most common shape in the Agent ID ecosystem. Check mintedBy(address) against the per-wallet cap before quoting a max mint.

failure_reasons: The free pool can be exhausted while the project card still advertises free
A second free share may secretly need an X-share voucher
patterns.mint_method: mint(0) at value 0 takes the free share. Later indices cost USDT or BNB and are never auto-bought.
patterns.name: EZbot-style share mint (index 0 free, later indices paid)
patterns.notes: Seen across many EZbot feed projects. Always prove the free index by a value-0 simulation from the actual wallet before recording a GO.
